name: [UPDATE] Turbo Soccer : Beta 1.0
desc:
🏎️ Welcome to Turbo Soccer! Beta version!

⚽ Hit the field and compete in car soccer against players from around the world!

🎮 Play competitive matches!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and show your skills!
🚗 Unlock exclusive cars and items!
✨ Customize your car with skins, wheels, decals, boosts, and more!
🔥 Master the mechanics and improve your skills!
🌎 Play across different arenas and maps!
👥 Play with your friends and build your team!
🏅 Compete, rank up, and become a legend!

🎁 NEWS COMING SOON!

🎮 Controls:
🖥️ PC: WASD + Mouse
📱 Mobile: On-screen controls
🎮 Console: Compatible controller
